exposure: History of clinically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
outcome: Maternal outcomes (24-hour blood loss, blood product transfusion, invasive cases, abdominal and pelvic organ injuries)
cohort: 339 women with pathologically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) out of 415,470 deliveries at three university-based tertiary referral centers from January 1, 2013, to December 31, 2022.
finding: 35% of patients with PAS were undiagnosed prior to delivery, and risk factors included history of intrauterine adhesions, history of clinically confirmed PAS, posterior placenta, and history of placenta previa.
